content: #2 The hypothesis of replacement of contexts asserts that the extension is unique up to a unique isomorphism of contexts. This doesn’t entail that each piece of the context, type or function, is separately unique up to a unique isomorphism. Uniqueness of the isomorphisms are only assumed as a unit.
